name: nexus-monorepo
description: Repository-level orchestration for the Nexus applications

scripts.build:contracts: npm run build --workspace=@nexus/character-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@nexus/document-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@nexus/rules-contracts && npm run build --workspace=@nexus/character-creator
scripts.build:vtt: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:all --workspace=nexus-vtt
scripts.build:forge: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=nexus-forge
scripts.build:codex: npm run build:contracts && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-api && npm run build --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-api && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-processor && npm run build --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-processor && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-websocket && npm run build --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-websocket && npm run build --workspace=admin-ui && npm run build --workspace=@nexuscodex/dm-ui
scripts.type-check: npm run build:contracts && npm run type-check --workspace=@nexus/character-creator && npm run type-check --workspace=nexus-vtt && npm exec --workspace=nexus-forge tsc -- --noEmit && npm run build:codex
scripts.test:forge: npm run lint --workspace=nexus-forge && npm run test --workspace=nexus-forge -- --run --coverage
scripts.test:codex: npm run test --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-api && npm run test --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-processor && npm run test --workspace=nexus-codex-doc-websocket
scripts.test:docs: npm run typecheck --workspace=@nexus/docs && npm run build:docs
